sections.title: Jeeva Kumari
sections.subtitle: Commerce Graduate & Dedicated Art Mentor Since 2005
sections.body: I am Jeeva Kumari. I am a graduate in commerce, but painting and sketching is my passion. Since 2005, I have been teaching drawing and painting to students of all ages with patient, hands-on guidance. I hold the certificate of Higher Grade Drawing Examination conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board (KSEEB), and I give coaching for lower and higher grade drawing exams.
sections.extendedBody: I teach professional watercolour techniques (wet-on-wet washes, blending, landscapes, florals, and portraits), acrylic painting, classic oil painting, fine pencil shading, and charcoal. I am well-versed in authentic Tanjore painting across every traditional stage—from board preparation, intricate gesso relief work, and Jaipur stone setting, to 22-karat real gold foil embossing and final detailed painting. Under our structured exam coaching curriculum, students develop first-class mastery in Object Drawing, Memory Drawing, Design, and Perspective.
sections.quote: You do not need natural talent to master art. With patient guidance, correct technique, and practice, anyone can excel.

sections.title: Karnataka Secondary Board Drawing Exams
sections.body: A focused six-month coaching programme for Lower and Higher Grade Drawing Examinations conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board (KSEEB). Open to students aged 10+ and adults. Build skill, confidence, and exam technique with structured mock practice.
sections.ageNote: Open to students aged 10+ and adults
